issues_in: NOTES.md 2026-08-11 refresh section (line 17) states 'verified: true for local-process/site-grading and incentive facts; verified: false for operational/energized status', but data.json carries no `verified` field (and no refresh-aligned `last_refreshed`), so the NOTES-documented verification policy is not encoded in the data.
fixed: Added top-level "verified": false to data.json, reflecting the NOTES.md 2026-08-11 policy that operational/energized status is not verified.

Added top-level "verification_notes" string encoding the full NOTES.md 2026-08-11 policy: verified true for local-process/site-grading and incentive facts (TMAPC CZ-565/PUD-871/preliminary plat recommendation, 2025-09-03 TID conformance vote, Tulsa County incentive districts, 2026-03-04 staff report recording site grading in construction phase and Phase I building-permit applications submitted); verified false for operational/energized status because no certificate of occupancy, PSO service/interconnection completion, energization, or live IT-load record was located.
Added top-level "last_refreshed": "2026-08-11" to match the refreshed-sibling convention (e.g. usdc-0095, usdc-0040 carry "last_refreshed": "2026-08-11" and a top-level "verified" boolean).
Validated data.json parses as valid JSON after the edit (python3 json.load check passed).
remaining_risks: The entry has no `history` array (pre-existing, not flagged for this center by the review); the 2026-08-11 status change is documented in NOTES.md and status_as_of_cutoff but not in a structured history entry - parent may decide whether to add one.
NOTES.md was not edited: it already states the verified policy, which is now encoded in data.json; no NOTES change was needed for this issue.
summary: Fixed the only flagged issue for usdc-0131: NOTES.md's 2026-08-11 verified policy is now encoded in data.json via top-level verified:false, a verification_notes string mirroring the split policy (true for local-process/site-grading and incentive facts, false for operational/energized status), and last_refreshed:2026-08-11 per sibling convention. data.json validated as valid JSON; no URL issues were flagged for this center.
